All wastewater entering the Fallbrook WRP is subjected to full tertiary treatment consisting of ... and chlorine disinfection.
Dechlorination of chlorinated effluent is accomplished with sodium bisulfite (NaHSO3).
Sludge from the secondary treatment processes at the Fallbrook WRP is aerobically digested...
Dewatered sludge is fed to a thermal dryer to meet Class A biosolids requirements.
Class A biosolids are utilized as fertilizer by local farmers.
The Discharger contracts with Denali Solid Solutions for transporting Class B biosolids for land application in Yuma, Arizona.
If the dryer is inoperative, dewatered sludge (Class B biosolids) is either sent to one of twelve drying beds for a minimum of three months...
Screenings from the headworks and solids from grit removal are washed and compacted prior to being hauled to a local landfill for disposal.
During high flows or emergency operating or maintenance periods, a 1.2- million-gallon (MG) secondary effluent equalization basin is available for temporary storage.
Additionally, the Fallbrook WRP has a 1.0- MG recycled water storage basin.
